evals.prompt: Claude Code keeps burning through my Max plan limits way faster than it used to. Figure out what in my setup is wasting tokens and tell me what to change.
assertions: Runs scripts/collect.py exactly once (via uv run or python3) instead of reading transcripts or config files itself
Does not Read or cat any file under ~/.claude/projects, ~/.codex/sessions, or any auth/credential file
Reads references/checks.md only through a grep for the check IDs that appear in the report, not the whole file
Every number in the answer (tokens, percentages, counts) appears in the collector's output
Presents a ranked list or table of fixes, each tied to a check ID or measured evidence
Offers to apply fixes but makes no file edits before the user picks which ones to apply

evals.prompt: /optimize-ai-setup I also use Codex a lot and I think my AGENTS.md files have grown too big. Audit that too.
assertions: Runs the collector and reports the Codex metrics section, or says Codex was not detected if the report says so
If CX-AGENTSMD-CAP fired, explains that Codex silently stops adding AGENTS.md content past project_doc_max_bytes (32 KiB default) and offers trimming or raising that key
Does not open ~/.codex/auth.json or read whole session JSONL files
Keeps the answer to a short snapshot plus a fix table, without restating the full report

evals.prompt: Audit my AI setup and then get rid of any skills and MCP servers I never actually use.
assertions: Lists the specific unused skills/servers from the report and asks the user to confirm which to change before editing anything
Proposes demoting or disabling (skillOverrides name-only/off, disable-model-invocation, /mcp disable, enabled = false) rather than deleting files or directories
Never runs rm, trash, or deletes a skill, plugin, or MCP config entry
Words usage as 'no uses in the last N days' rather than claiming the item is never used
